title: {{ .service }} · error ratio per client
description: A client has > {{ .ratio_pct }}% errors and at least {{ .min_errors }} errors in 10 min. Runbook: {{ .runbook }}

input.value:
fetch spans, from:-1h
| filter service.name == "{{ .service }}" and span.kind == "server"
| makeTimeseries { total = count(), errors = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 500) }, by:{ client.id }, interval:10m
| fieldsAdd guarded_ratio = iCollectArray(if(errors[] >= {{ .min_errors }}, 100 * errors[] / total[], else: 0))
| fields timeframe, interval, client.id, guarded_ratio

properties.value: {{ .service }}: a client sees too many errors
